_comment: Pins kept more than 25 km from their Wikidata coordinates ON PURPOSE. The Wikidata lint (node scripts/lint-data.mjs --wikidata) skips these. Give every entry a reason a reader can check. Remove an entry if Wikidata is corrected.
noche-triste: Wikidata's coordinates are wrong; the causeway retreat was in Tenochtitlan (Mexico City), where the pin is. Checked 13 Oct 2026.
pharsalus: The battlefield's site is disputed; the pin follows the Wikipedia article. Checked 13 Oct 2026.
midway: A carrier battle fought over hundreds of km of ocean; the pin is on the atoll the fight was for.
coral-sea: A carrier battle fought over hundreds of km of ocean; the pin sits in the middle of it.
britain-1940: An air campaign over all of southern England; the pin is on London and the south-east.
carthage-146bce: Wikipedia links the Third Punic War as a whole; the pin is on Carthage, where it ended.
kursk: Wikidata pins the battle on Kursk city. The pin is on Prokhorovka, where the great tank clash of 12 July 1943 was fought (13 Oct 2026 review).
